prompt.project_info: A seaside sunset fashion portrait with metallic-gold fabric, rocky Mediterranean coast, and restrained jewelry.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with a full feminine silhouette, relaxed blonde bob, understated makeup, gold hoop earrings, and a few gold bangles. She wears a metallic golden-bronze form-fitting sleeveless maxi dress with a flattering neckline and a flowing skirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-length portrait on a pebbled Mediterranean beach. Rocky cliffs, calm ocean, and a distant sailboat form the background; pose is upright and relaxed, with no explicit body-part emphasis, text, or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight at 3800K creates warm sheen on metallic fabric, sunlight highlighting shoulders and chest area, realistic shadows enhancing curves, soft face shadows, pebbles, sea texture, and gentle wind in the bob.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 50mm lens at f/2.8, vertical 3:4 crop, crisp fabric and coastline, mild background blur, natural grain and highlight roll-off.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Sunset fashion editorial of an adult woman with a full feminine silhouette and a relaxed blonde bob standing upright on a pebbled Mediterranean beach. She wears a metallic golden-bronze form-fitting sleeveless maxi dress with a flattering neckline and flowing skirt, gold hoop earrings, and a few gold bangles. Rocky cliffs, calm ocean, and a distant sailboat behind her; warm golden-hour light creates sheen on fabric, highlights shoulders and chest area, and casts realistic shadows enhancing curves. Natural skin and pebble texture, vertical framing, no text, logos, or public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep neckline, thigh-high slit, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers
